status: Implemented and locally verified; not landed. All prior review/landing holds remain.

authority.request: Remove the transient node-status message and implement the diagnosed viewer/GPU/upload repairs.

changes: One worker-owned ViewIntent resolves the current description, demand, keys and execution; independent metadata-only consumers retain Describe.
Native binding v7: four stored channels use packed RGBA32F; other counts retain scalar planes. Names/order and auxiliary values are preserved.
Canonical RGBA avoids dynamic shader component indexing. Identity viewer/replay images are retained without projection.
Software/still RGBA uploads copy directly to staging; hardware decode remains device-resident. Input OCIO stays in-place.
Normal in-flight viewer diagnostics are empty; real unavailable/error states and recovery remain.

internal_cpp_api_changes: uploadNativeImage, cropNativeImage, MediaInterop RGBA32F entry points

checks.full_debug_suite: Run once (762 cases then). All repair failures were fixed and rerun; one pre-existing Viewer.InterpretationMapIsParsedStrictly failure remains (obsolete colorimetry fixture field). The invalid standalone single-frame playback fixture was removed; its one-request/no-overlay assertions extend the existing mixed-media native playback test. No claim that the full suite is green.

asan_ubsan.scope: Packed upload/crop/input OCIO, prepared-plan origin, retained image/source lifetime, scalar publication completion, four named data channels, destination supersession/cancellation, viewport-less metadata and current-frame view resolution. Existing LSAN preset suppressions only; no new suppression.

native_ui.first_case_extended: Checks exactly one completed worker request and an empty real viewerDiagnostic while a new frame is in flight.

integration_defects_fixed: Materialize a Slang image load before dynamic component indexing to avoid invalid vector OpImageTexelPointer.
Size packed diagnostic readback for all stored samples; download packed pixels directly.
Preserve opaque default alpha for a projected RGB/scalar view without stored alpha.
Retain viewport-less header description and mark unavailable-view metadata as answered.

performance.environment: NVIDIA GTX 1070, native Linux Qt/Vulkan; validation disabled only for timing. User app/desktop left open. GPU probes serialized with flock.
performance.workload: Preserved Read1 -> Blur1(size 1) -> Viewer1; 1920x1080 H.264, 650 frames, source 25fps. Copied project has only its presentation envelope removed, avoiding a restore prompt; evaluation content unchanged. Auto delivers 960x540, Full 1920x1080.
performance.baseline_binary: Preserved 1fe3aa4 release objects/headers/shaders; not a reconstructed pre-#90 whole-app baseline.
performance.observation: Six-second processes. End-to-end latency is playhead change to the observed framePresented signal, paired by frame and stopped at the summary. Raw render-request latency has a changed starting boundary and is not compared.

limitations: Earlier native observer timings had a capture-lifetime bug and are superseded. Intermediate corrected runs still showed a project-presentation prompt; final-* runs use the unobstructed surface.
All native observers required the existing teardown watchdog after measurement; this is not graceful-shutdown evidence.
Shared-GPU timings are noisy. Warm replay was exercised, but its latency did not improve consistently; do not claim universal p95 or replay-latency gains.
No hosted CI, Windows run, push, merge, or issue closure.
Unrelated user workflow/autosave/backup files and root comp.spv are excluded.
